_doc: IBKR Pro tiered commission schedule. Each rule has a key matching the cost_model.py classification (asset_class, market). Values denominated in `currency`. Refresh from https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/pricing/commissions-home.php when the schedule changes.
_edit_authority: ⚑ THIS FILE IS READ-ONLY TO EVERY AGENT (hq CLAUDE.md convention 8). The
2026-08-12 edit to the three EU_STK_* min_per_order values was made by
Claude Code under Marcel's EXPLICIT per-edit authorisation, asked for and
given in session: 'EBS, yes, we have to use what is actually being
charged'. It is NOT a precedent and does not amend the convention, which
is his to amend (0b vii). Read the git history that way.
Why this one is admissible where a hand-edit would not be. S1-33 forbids
ASSUMED costs; these are MEASURED — 137 live European fills over two
sessions, every one with its exec_exchange and charged commission
recorded. asset_class_buckets.json's own note anticipated exactly this
edit when it said broker_ibkr.json was left untouched on 2026-08-11
because 'those are rates, and the live batch measures them'. The batch
has now measured them. Nothing here was chosen by anyone.
⚑ WHAT THE NEW VALUES ARE, AND ARE NOT. min_per_order now holds the
ROUTING-WEIGHTED charge per order across the venues SMART actually
reaches for that line — which is what a retail client pays in
expectation, and follows the same 'cost per user, not cost per venue'
call that made the European cells route SMART in the first place. It is
no longer the schedule minimum; that is kept beside it as
_min_per_order_schedule, and _min_per_order_measured_n carries the fill
count behind each.
⚑ VALID WHERE THE MINIMUM BINDS, UNKNOWN ABOVE IT. Every measurement is
at one share, so it cannot say whether a venue's excess over schedule
(EBS: CHF 3.58 against 1.50) is a flat per-order fee that persists at
size or a rate that the per_value_bps line already captures. Above
roughly CHF 3,215 of notional the 6 bps rate binds and this correction
stops applying — if the excess is flat, the model under-states there.
Settling it needs fills at a second notional. Not measured, not assumed.
⚑ THE ROUTING MIX IS AN OBSERVATION, NOT A CONSTANT. These weights are
SMART's behaviour on two days in August 2026. If IBKR changes its
routing the weights move and these numbers go stale silently, because
nothing re-derives them. Re-measure before treating them as current.
=== 2026-09-08 — SESSION 3, AND THE SIX RATE ===
The re-measurement the paragraph above asks for was run on 2026-09-08
(H-4 session 3), after Marcel confirmed the account flat in chat. The
three min_per_order values are repooled over ALL one-share fills, and
EU_STK_SIX.per_value_bps moves 6.0 -> 5.0. Record, with the full
arithmetic and every call: batches/2026-09-08-W8-record.md.
⚑ per_value_bps 6.0 -> 5.0 IS MARCEL'S CALL, NOT A LANE'S. Written by
Claude Code under his EXPLICIT per-edit authorisation, verbatim: 'Marcel's
call: EU_STK_SIX.per_value_bps -> 5.0 from today's twelve fills at 23
shares (zero variance); W8 writes it with the fills as _edit_authority.'
This is the SECOND use of the 2026-08-12 pattern above, not a new
mechanism, and like that one it is NOT a precedent and does not amend
convention 8, which is his to amend (0b vii).
THE FILLS BEHIND IT. Twelve MKT_RAW fills at 23 shares (CHF 3,873-3,879
notional), runs 20260908T083909Z / T084455Z / T084635Z. Implied rate
5.00000000-5.00000026 bps, sigma 7.1e-08. The 6.0 was transcribed from
IBKR's published page on 2026-05-04 and had never been measured; at this
notional it predicts CHF 2.3239-2.3275 against CHF 1.9366-1.9396 charged.
⚑ WHY THIS IS THE RATE AND NOT THE FLOOR — the variation, not the level.
5.0 bps charges CHF 1.9387 here against a routing-weighted min_per_order
of 1.9291: CHF 0.0096 apart, which no single fill could separate. But the
charge tracks the fill price proportionally — commission max/min and
notional max/min are the SAME ratio, 1.001543943, to nine decimal places,
across eight distinct commission values. A floor would have been constant.
⚑ WHAT THE 5.0 DOES NOT COVER. All twelve fills were EUDARK (11) or
TRWBCH (1). ZERO EBS fills landed at the second notional in 12 draws
against a 20% arrival share, so CTS-14 IS STILL OPEN: whether EBS's
excess over schedule (CHF 3.58 vs 1.50 at one share, now 8 of 8 with zero
variance) is a flat add-on or a rate is exactly as unknown as before.
The second notional was attempted and did not land. n = 0, reported
blank; the CHF 1.50 schedule figure does not ship.
⚑ SESSION COUNT IS NOT EVIDENCE COUNT. Session 3 is n = 12 on XETRA,
n = 6 on SIX and n = 4 on LSE. Only XETRA reproduced (EUR 0.0008 from
August). On SIX one EBS draw either way moves the session figure by CHF
0.347 — more than the CHF 0.0123 the pooled value actually moved — so
session 3 does not contradict August there, and cannot confirm it either.
H-4's target is >= 5 sessions and all three lines stand at 3.
_as_of is deliberately left at 2026-05-04: it tracks the SCHEDULE
vintage, not the measurement. Measurement dates live in each notes field,
following the 2026-08-12 edit's own convention.

US_STK.notes: Tiered for monthly volume <300k shares; lower rates above. Pro tier; IBKR Lite is $0 commission but worse fills.

US_ETF.notes: Same schedule as US_STK on Pro tiered. Some ETFs are commission-free under IBKR Lite or specific programmes.

US_SMALL_CAP_STK.notes: Same Pro tiered schedule as US_STK. Separate key only so the calculator can apply small-cap-specific spread medians from the harness.

EU_STK_XETRA.notes: XETRA (DE). 5 bps, capped at €99. min_per_order is the ROUTING-WEIGHTED charge measured over 73 live SMART fills across three sessions (2026-08-11/12, 2026-09-08), not the €1.25 schedule minimum: EUDARK/GETTEX2/TRWBEN charge €1.25 exactly, IBIS2 charges ~€1.2992 (mean of 20). Session 3 (n=12) landed within €0.0008 of the August figure — the only one of the three lines that reproduced.

EU_STK_LSE.notes: LSE main market (UK). 5 bps, capped at 1.49% of trade value. min_per_order is the ROUTING-WEIGHTED charge over 46 live SMART fills across three sessions (2026-08-11/12, 2026-09-08), not the £1.00 schedule minimum: EUDARK/TRWBUKETF charge £1.00 exactly, LSEETF charges £1.16. Session 3 added only 4 fills (LSEETF 1, TRWBUKETF 1, EUDARK 2) — consistent with August, too thin to confirm it. Separately, the three CSP1 SELL-as-entry cells timed out that session and are recorded EMPTY, not zero; SELL-as-exit filled normally on the same line.

EU_STK_SIX.notes: SIX Swiss Exchange. 5 bps, capped at CHF 99. per_value_bps is MEASURED, not read off the schedule: 12 live fills at 23 shares on 2026-09-08 imply 5.00000000-5.00000026 bps (sigma 7.1e-08), and the charge tracks notional proportionally, so it is the rate and not the floor. The 6.0 here until 2026-09-08 was transcribed from IBKR's published page on 2026-05-04 and had never been measured; Marcel's call to replace it is in _edit_authority. Those 12 fills were all EUDARK/TRWBCH — no EBS fill landed at that notional, so EBS above the floor is still unmeasured (CTS-14 open). min_per_order is the ROUTING-WEIGHTED charge over 40 live SMART fills across three sessions (2026-08-11/12, 2026-09-08), not the CHF 1.50 schedule minimum. EBS — the SIX primary — charges CHF 3.58, 2.39x the schedule, on 8 of 8 fills with zero variance; EUDARK/TRWBCH charge CHF 1.50 exactly and take 77.5% of the flow. Session 3 was only n=6 here: one EBS draw either way moves it CHF 0.347, so it does not confirm August.

FX_IDEALPRO.notes: IDEALPRO spot FX. 0.20 bps of trade value with $2 minimum. Commission charged in account base currency.

CFD_FX.notes: Mirrors IDEALPRO pricing for forex CFDs.

CFD_INDEX.notes: Index CFDs. Schedule varies per region; check pricing page.

FUT_CME.notes: ES/NQ/RTY (e-mini index). Exchange fee bundled into commissionReport. Total typically ~$2.25/side.

FUT_NYBOT.notes: ICE US futures: DX (USD index), KC (coffee), CC (cocoa), CT (cotton), SB (sugar). Total ~$2.22/side.

FUT_EUREX.notes: FESX (Euro Stoxx 50), FDAX (DAX), etc. Refresh per-product fee from EUREX schedule.
